credits.title: The Great Family
credits.overview: Inspired by true events, the film follows a young man struggling to reclaim his freedom inside a shelter ruled by a woman whose authority blends maternal care with strict control. As he navigates loyalty, fear, and the desire to escape, the fragile boundaries between protection and domination begin to unravel.

credits.title: The Last Christeros
credits.overview: The plot occurs around 1925 in Mexico when the Mexican government decides to severely restrict religious freedoms. It is the story of a few rebels, The Cristeros that fight for the right to freely and publicly practice their Catholic faith. The movie follows a few of those rebels with their doubts and their struggles.
